name: Out-of-bounds Read
remediation_prompt: Add strict contract bounds for index parameters so every array access is provably in range.
correction_guidance: Add conditional postconditions: valid indices return arr[index]; invalid indices return -1. Add the runtime bounds guard required to satisfy them.
